theme.philosophy: Architectural Swiss - A hybrid of 'Zoho Books' enterprise precision and modern 'Earthy/Organic' construction aesthetics. Information-dense, extremely polished, with high contrast structural greys and vibrant Amber accents.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for construction.
rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Data tables and financial ledgers must use tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) in IBM Plex Sans.
Avoid #000000 or #FFFFFF for pure backgrounds; always tint with Slate.
Amber/Brand Accent is reserved strictly for primary actions, current active states, and the 'RA' in the Sitera logo.
Do not use gradients for data-heavy sections (ledgers, tables).

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards instead of standard p-4. Container padding should be px-4 sm:px-8.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for dashboards. Dense, high-utilization grid for analytics (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). gap-4 or gap-6.

borders_and_radii.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons, rounded-md for inputs.
borders_and_radii.style: Use crisp 1px borders (border-border/60) to separate components instead of heavy drop shadows.

surfaces.cards: Solid background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.
surfaces.headers: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 with 1px bottom border.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Primary actions use brand_accent or text_primary inverted. Add explicit hover states (hover:bg-slate-800 text-white).
components.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, DatePicker. Background should match surface, 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-brand_accent/50.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. MUST have horizontal scrolling wrapper for mobile. Sticky headers. Hover states on rows (hover:bg-muted/50). Tabular data right-aligned.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Do not use generic full-width pills; use refined bottom-border active states (Architectural UI) or subtle segmented controls.
components.drawers_and_modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for desktop (max-w-2xl usually) and Shadcn Sheet (bottom/side drawer) for mobile views to preserve screen real estate.
components.kpi_cards: Flat, cardless feel or 1px bordered boxes. Use large numeric typography (text-3xl font-semibold) with a subtle icon in the top right. Include trend indicators (e.g., +2.5%).
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' library. Position bottom-right for desktop, top-center for mobile.

auth_and_public.desktop: Split screen: left side architectural/construction abstract visual, right side clean login form.
auth_and_public.mobile: Single column, focus on form. Estimate-approval public page must look like a polished invoice document.

admin_dashboard.desktop: Top row: 5 KPI stat cards. Middle: Overall Portfolio (Donut) + Projects by Status (Bar). Bottom: Gantt chart + Milestones.
admin_dashboard.mobile: KPI cards become a horizontal swipeable list (snap-x). Charts stack vertically with full width.

projects.desktop: Tabbed navigation (Overview, Phases, Tracking, etc.). Balance Sheet tab features a strict 7-column table with 'Opening Balance b/f' as first row and 'Totals c/f' as last row.
projects.mobile: Tabs become a scrollable horizontal list or a select dropdown. Balance Sheet MUST have sticky first column (Date/Voucher) and horizontal scroll for the rest. Preserve 7 columns.

field_ops_portal.desktop: Clean, large touch-friendly rows for attendance marking (P/A/HD).
field_ops_portal.mobile: PRIORITY: Needs to function like a native mobile app. Large tap targets for marking attendance. Floating Action Button (FAB) for adding labour payment.

clients_and_finance.desktop: Rich data tables. Indian-comma currency formatting is STRICTLY required (e.g., ₹1,06,91,08,000.00).
clients_and_finance.mobile: Collapse less critical table columns behind an 'expand' chevron, or use card-based list views instead of standard tables.

estimates_and_vendors.desktop: Estimate list shows masonry or grid of drawing thumbnails. Quotation UI looks like a live spreadsheet.
estimates_and_vendors.mobile: Thumbnails in a standard vertical feed. Quotation creation is split into step-by-step mobile forms.

navigation_ia.sidebar: Desktop: Fixed left sidebar (w-64). Contains the wordmark 'SITERA' and 'S+' logo mark. Collapsible into icon-only mode.
navigation_ia.mobile_drawer: Mobile: Hidden on load, toggled via hamburger menu in a sticky top nav. Uses Shadcn Sheet (left side).
navigation_ia.breadcrumbs: Required on all deep pages (e.g., Projects > Project Name > Change Orders).

motion_and_microinteractions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in (opacity 0 to 1) and slight upward slide (translate-y-4 to 0) using Framer Motion on route change.
motion_and_microinteractions.interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active (scale: 0.98). Table rows subtle background shift on hover. Stat cards lift up 2px on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Muted text must still be readable on Slate 50 or Slate 950.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-amber-500).
accessibility.keyboard: Preserve keyboard navigation for tabs and tables.

avatars.description: Woman portrait for Client/Admin avatar placeholder
Man portrait for Site Engineer/Vendor avatar placeholder

thumbnails.description: Architectural blueprints for Estimate thumbnail placeholder

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT change any route paths, API endpoints, or data-testid names. The QA suite depends on them.
CRITICAL: Preserve the exact 7-column Balance Sheet ledger structure.
CRITICAL: Preserve the Indian-comma currency formatter (₹1,06,91,08,000).
CRITICAL: Preserve the role-based navigation visibility logic (JWT auth based).
CRITICAL: Implement the logo strictly as: SITERA.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively but customize classes to match the 'Architectural Swiss' theme (crisp borders, exact padding).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; strictly use Shadcn dropdowns and datepickers.
Mobile view is Priority #1. Ensure tables scroll horizontally and KPI cards snap-scroll.
Always apply transitions for interactive elements; avoid 'transition: all' to prevent breaking transforms.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp, enterprise-grade iconography.
Ensure 'sonner' is used for all toasts.
Do not center-align app containers; respect natural reading flow for dense text and data.
